substantive_unit.finding: The pinned official Cargo configuration reference documents net.offline as a boolean (default false, environment CARGO_NET_OFFLINE) where true makes Cargo avoid network access and attempt to proceed with locally cached data; it can also be overridden by the --offline command-line option. The same file documents source replacement using source.<name>.replace-with and local directory/local-registry source paths.
substantive_unit.phase1_relevance: This establishes an open-source configuration-level mechanism for forcing no-network dependency behavior and naming local source replacements without hosted-runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud-credit, or external API execution. It does not establish that a particular build succeeds offline, that all required dependency data is locally present, or that scheduled Chat can execute Cargo.
